difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y and g : Y -> Z local complete intersection morphisms of schemes locally of finite type over (S, delta), assuming the Gysin map exists for g o f and for g, the lemma asserts that the Gysin map exists for f and that (g o f)^! = f^! o g^! (statement lines 13574-13581). The proof notes that g o f is local complete intersection by More on Morphisms, Lemma labelled more-morphisms-lemma-composition-lci, so the statement makes sense, and that an immersion X -> P into a scheme P smooth over Z gives an immersion X -> P x_Z Y into a scheme smooth over Y, which proves existence for f (proof lines 13583-13590). Choosing moreover an immersion Y -> P' with P' smooth over Z, the proof sets up the commutative diagram with P x_Z Y, P x_Z P', X and Y, notes that the horizontal arrows are regular immersions, the south-west arrows smooth and the square cartesian, and records that a^! o q^* = p^* o b^! because bivariant classes commute with flat pullback (proof lines 13592-13606). Combining this with the composition formula for regular immersions (Lemma labelled lemma-composition-regular-immersion) and the composition of flat pullbacks (Lemma labelled lemma-compose-flat-pullback) gives the assertion; the author ends with 'Small detail omitted' (proof lines 13608-13610). Factoring the two local complete intersection morphisms into regular immersions and smooth morphisms so that the comparison square applies is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
